citations.claim: Energy just before collision within tolerance
Heavy body almost stationary before impact
First violation: energy massively exceeds allowed 1974 J
Heavy body unphysically accelerated to 51 m/s
Heavy body vx shows large momentum gain

counterfactual.change: Reduced bodies[1].vx from -47.877 to -5 (single field) to lower impact kinetic energy; same steps/dt/gravity. Passing run confirms high-speed collision is necessary for blow-up.

explanation: Energy jumps from ~1790 J at step 6 to 23888 J at step 7 during collision of fast light body (m=1, vx=-47.87) with heavy near-static body (m=16.94). Post-collision, heavy body gains vx=-43.8 / speed 51.2 from near zero, while light body keeps high speed, giving ~15x momentum increase (from -47.8 to ~-787). This indicates impulse calculation bug: momentum non-conservation and massive artificial energy injection during high-speed circle-circle collision, possibly inverted mass ratio or positional correction adding velocity instead of position, amplified by 24 substeps.
vision_note: Steps 4-6 show two blue circles slowly drifting left while approaching each other. At step 7 they make contact and the left larger circle abruptly jumps down-left with visible overlap, indicating a sudden large velocity gain at collision.
